# Updates selector candidate

Grounding: Updates already receives both lists through its server page model; their ordering, declaration counts, and registration timestamps are authoritative. Rankings owns feature selection while CategoryWheel owns pressed-button interaction. RankingList assumes ranked financial rows, bars, and incomplete-total semantics. ResultRow is the appropriate existing row primitive.

## Recommended shape

Keep Updates as a single page with the Rankings intro arrangement: title and existing month at left, a 220px CategoryWheel at right, then one full-width results list. Default to MPs. Mobile stacks the selector beneath the title. Remove the redundant section heading once the selector and accessible list name identify the category; introduce no explanatory copy.

Feature API in `lib/updates.ts`:

```ts
type UpdateCategory = "members" | "companies";
const updateCategories: CategoryWheelOption<UpdateCategory>[];
```

Page state is `selected: UpdateCategory`; derive `data.updates?.[selected] ?? []`. Keep existing EntityUpdate values directly rather than introducing another presentation-row interface. Derive the selected category descriptor once for label/icon/accent, and retain existing member/funder URL mapping. Render keyed rows using `${selected}:${row.id}` so both category switches and initial mount animate. No fetch, timeout, artificial loading state, or client-side sort is needed.

Use two existing, geometrically valid quadrant designs: MPs upper-left and Companies lower-right, with their existing 142px-local paths and positions. Only those two buttons are present. This requires no CategoryWheel contract change and guarantees hit targets match drawn sectors. Keep the two feature options explicit in Updates; a future geometry extraction can eliminate identical drawing constants if justified, but Updates should not import financial rankings adapters. Do not invent 284px-high semicircles inside CategoryWheel's 142px button boxes.

Extend ResultRow minimally with `enterDelay?: number` (milliseconds). When present, its own root receives an entry class and delay style. The component owns a 250ms translateY(6px)-to-zero animation; preserve full opacity so SSR content is continuously visible. Updates passes `Math.min(index, 4) * 25`, capping the entire effect at 350ms regardless of row count. Reduced motion disables the animation. Existing ResultRow callers remain unchanged. Document this public prop and add a gallery example.

## Alternatives and decision

Reusing RankingList would require fictitious amounts, width, and incomplete values or a new variant that weakens its financial contract. Reject it. A dedicated UpdateList would add a component and presentation mapping for a single caller without hiding meaningful complexity. Prefer the existing ResultRow plus narrowly owned motion.

Risks: two opposite quadrants are visually sparse; inspect desktop/mobile before delivery. Ensure animation never obscures links or changes keyboard focus, and switching back recreates rows without resetting selector focus.

Tests: default MPs; mouse/keyboard Companies selection and pressed state; both entity URLs; unchanged row order/count/date; empty/error states; entry animation and reduced-motion override; no horizontal overflow. Run check/build and affected Playwright/gallery tests; capture desktop screenshots for PR.
